title: Backfill staged commit coverage
summary: Backfilled change-control coverage for the staged repository changes included in the user-requested commit.
reason: The strict staged coverage gate requires every staged path to appear in at least one unreleased change packet before commit.
behavior_before: The staged commit set included paths that were not listed in any unreleased change packet, so coverage validation failed.
behavior_after: The staged commit set is listed in an unreleased change packet, with the root CON local config artifact intentionally left unstaged.
manual_validation: git -c core.longpaths=true add -A -- . ':!CON' - staged all repo changes except root CON local config artifact
rollback_plan: Revert this packet update if the staged commit is abandoned or replace it with more specific packet coverage before release finalization.
notes: Backfilled staged path coverage before user-requested commit; root CON was not staged because it is a Windows-reserved local Codex config artifact.
